newsitem.title: UK: August world oil output down to 71.9 mbpd - IEA.
newsitem.headline: August world oil output down to 71.9 mbpd - IEA.

text.p: World oil production in August averaged 71.9 million barrels per day (bpd), down from July's 72.1 million bpd, the International Energy Agency said.
The Paris-based agency, which serves as the West's energy watchdog, said OPEC crude oil production last month averaged 25.81 million bpd compared to 25.88 million bpd in July.

In its end-August Monthly Oil Market Report, the IEA said seven of 11 OPEC counties recorded higher output in August but the combined declines in three countries -- Saudi Arabia, Indonesia and the UAE -- were "almost twice as large" as the combined increases.

The IEA said production outside the Organisation of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) dippped to 43.4 million bpd reflecting reduced Latin American output following an explosion at a natural gas processing plant in Mexico and pipeline bombings in Colombia.
Maintenance work in Alaska and the North Sea "more than offset gains" in Asian production from China and India, Africa and Russia and Kazakhstan.
Including natural gas liquids, supply from the 11 OPEC members totalled 28.53 million bpd from 28.56 million in July, the IEA said.
